title: Free day in Cusco

weather.note: Classic Cusco; bright sunny ~21°C, cold once the sun dips. Great for a high hike — start early, layer up.

glance: Your one truly flexible day. Big-adventure option (Rainbow Mountain, Humantay) or a relaxed art-market-and-café crawl through San Blas — a lighter day here is smart before Titicaca.

picks.name: Palcoyo Rainbow Mountain
picks.note: Quieter, easier alternative to Vinicunca; three rainbow ridges, less crowd. Long day at altitude.

picks.name: Humantay Lake
picks.note: Turquoise glacial lake below a snow peak; gorgeous, a real leg-burner.

picks.name: San Blas artisan quarter
picks.note: Cobbled galleries & workshops; Casa Mérida ceramics, Mendívil figures, the 7 Angelitos alley.

picks.name: ChocoMuseo
picks.note: Bean-to-bar chocolate workshops and a pisco/coffee/chocolate tasting; fun and hands-on.
